purpose: Focused staging attempt for the four CC0 Quaternius character/animation packs used by the P1C01 Frodo/Gandalf skeletal-candidate wave.
rules: Capture the license shown on each official pack page; do not infer a blanket provider license for older/newer packs.
Only public downloads discovered from the official Quaternius pack pages are eligible.
Animated production-character output accepted by the project remains FBX only even if the source pack also contains OBJ/glTF/Blend.
Creature/monster packs are pipeline/support stock only; canonical hero creatures still require species-specific art, real rigs, deformation review and visual acceptance.
If a pack resolves only to an interactive store page, record it as unresolved/manual-source rather than inventing a direct URL.
Downloaded archives stay STAGED until extracted/scanned and FBX/PNG/TGA intake checks pass.
Observed CC0 capture authorizes staging attempts only; public-download discovery and receipt/SHA256 evidence are still required before STAGED.
notes: Focused subset only. Store/manual-only links remain unresolved; no bypass is allowed. Staging success does not imply rig/skin/deformation or READY_FOR_IMPORT.
